title: Impact of "Long Island" Project along East Coast Parkway on Marine Habitats and Property Prices in the Area
what_it_is: Impact of "Long Island" Project along East Coast Parkway on Marine Habitats and Property Prices in the Area

sections.label: Long Island reclamation environmental studies
sections.summary: Before Long Island reclamation, environmental studies, nature-based solutions, and public engagement will be conducted, with coastal protection and land creation as key considerations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As with all other land reclamation projects, before we proceed with the "Long Island" reclamation, detailed environmental studies will be conducted to assess the environmental impacts and to develop appropriate mitigating measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will also explore ways to incorporate nature-based solutions into the design of "Long Island" to minimise the environmental impact of the reclamation as we seek to tackle the effects of sea-level rise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will engage the nature community, academics and researchers and the public for feedback on the environmental studies and mitigation measures before commencing reclamation work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our key considerations are the need for coastal protection for the low-lying East Coast area due to future sea-level rise and the need to create land to meet Singapore's longer-term developmental needs. "Long Island" will integrate coastal protection measures with our reclamation plans while strengthening our flood resilience and water supply.

sections.label: Long Island planning timeline
sections.summary: Planning and implementing Long Island will take a few decades given its scale.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Given its scale, planning and implementing of "Long Island" will take a few decades.

sections.label: Sand procurement tender requirements
sections.summary: JTC and other agencies procure sand commercially, with tender specifications requiring operators to comply with source country rules and regulations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I said earlier, JTC and other agencies that procure sand, procure it on a commercial basis from operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are requirements in the specifications for tender that the operators who import the sand comply with certain rules and regulations, particularly those of the source country.

sections.label: Sand procurement compliance monitoring
sections.summary: Tender specifications require compliance with local laws and standards, and agencies receive information from various sources on non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Well, as I have mentioned earlier, the tender specifications and contractual requirements require compliance with local laws and regulations and certain standards that are set out and expected by the agencies procuring the sand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And the agencies will look out for and receive information from a variety of sources, if there is a sense of non-compliance with any of these contractual terms as well as with regulatory groups.

sections.label: Site-specific surveys and sea-level rise
sections.summary: Site-specific surveys started in 2021, with sea levels expected to rise up to 1.15 metres by end of century above mean sea levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In 2021, we started a series of site-specific surveys.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We know that sea levels are expected to rise up to 1.15 metres by the end of this century, above mean sea levels.

sections.label: Long Wall coastal protection concept
sections.summary: The Long Wall concept involves a 14-kilometre wall about three metres tall with 12 pumping stations and tidal gates from city to East Coast.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The other is actually what I call the "Long Wall" concept, where you take a stretch of 14 kilometres from city to East Coast, along the existing East Coast, and you build a wall, roughly around three metres tall, with 12 pumping stations and tidal gates along the whole stretch.

sections.label: Long Island purpose and sand
sections.summary: Passage states Long Island's purposes: coastal protection, water resilience, more land, keeping East Coast Park, and raises sand import law concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That will be an opportunity for residents, Singaporeans and stakeholders to have a better sense of the broad concepts and ideas that we may have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But broadly, the purpose of "Long Island" is: first and foremost, coastal protection; second, enhance our water resilience; third, create more land and opportunities for future generations of Singaporeans; and lastly, to keep the East Coast Park largely as it is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: If I could go back just to the issue of sand again.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I understand that with the sand imports, we are reliant on compliance with the local laws, but I think the concern is that the local laws might not be as strong as we hope for them to be.
